# dsh-qq-plugin
Drive the DeepSeek Harness agent on this computer from your phone, in QQ.

It goes through **Tencent's official QQ bot platform** (`api.bot.qq.com`, bound by scanning a QR
cod

e), so there is **no public IP to expose, no reverse proxy, and no third-party protocol client**
in
the middle. Bind once, and it keeps working.
**Runs on the current DSH desktop app** — developed and tested against DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`.

This is the QQ counterpart of dsh-wechat-plugin. It is
feature-aligned with it, with a few deliberat

e departures where the QQ protocol makes the WeChat
machinery unnecessary — see Differences from the

re the QQ protocol makes the WeChat
machinery unnecessary — see Differences from the WeChat version.

> is the attachment entry: images, videos, voice and files all go in that way

## Features

- **Text both ways.** A QQ message becomes a DSH prompt, and the reply comes back to QQ.
- **Images,

files and voice in; images, videos and files out.** Attachments are saved into the
session workspac

e and handed to the agent; the agent sends files back with `send_to_qq`.
**A reply that runs long is

turned into a `.md` file** and sent to your phone instead of being cut.
- **One QQ chat, many DSH c

onversations.** `/new`, `/list`, `/switch`, `/current`, `/cancel` — or
just say "switch to the other

one". The list has **session folders** and **sessions** as two levels.
- **Pick the model and the r

easoning level from your phone too.** `/model` lists the models with
each one's reasoning levels; `/

model 2` and `/model 等级 high` switch them, effective from the
**next** step.
- **Answer permission p

rompts and questions from your phone.** Approvals are answered with
「允许」/「拒绝」 (allow/deny) or a numb

ered option; the agent's multiple-choice questions arrive in
QQ with numbered options and a digit an

swers them — being away from the desk does not stall the task.
- **Proactive push.** `notify_qq` let

s any session on this machine message you — that is what makes
"tell me when it is done" work. It wo

rks in practice: a ten-message burst was delivered in full,
and the last six of those went out as pr

oactive pushes. (Tencent's rules for unsolicited sends can
change and **the plugin assumes no quota*

*; anything undelivered is queued and flushed the next
time you speak.)
- **Scheduled tasks.** Run t

hrough the DSH host's own `schedule_create` / `schedule_list` /
`schedule_delete` / `schedule_update

` — just say "wake me at 23:12". The plugin does not
reimplement what DSH already has; it is only th

e channel.
- **Settings page** under **Settings → QQ** — nine settings, a native folder picker, and
**Settings page** under **Settings → QQ** — nine settings, a native folder picker, and diagnostics.
## Install

**For the DSH desktop app** on a machine that stays on. It needs DSH's workspace, tool and UI
servic
es — the standard desktop composition.

| DSH desktop | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop` `0.2.0-rc.2` or newer |
| Phone | mobile QQ, to scan one

QR code |
| QQ bot | **nothing to register in advance.** The bot application is created by that scan

; you do not need an AppID/AppSecret beforehand |
| Tencent's rules | an **uncertified** bot is usab
le only by its administrator — that is, only by you, which is exactly what a personal remote control
by its administrator — that is, only by you, which is exactly what a personal remote control wants |

Open the **plugin** entry in the sidebar and choose **添加插件** (add plugin). The field takes a
package
name, a Git URL, a tarball, or a local path.

> ### The name to install is `dsh-qq-plugin`
>
> The repository and the package share one name, so t

here is nothing to reconcile — but the
> `-plugin` suffix is easy to drop by accident. **Copy `dsh-q

q-plugin` rather than typing it.** The
[该节后续省略]
## Security
**Only you can reach it.** The channel talks to Tencent's official QQ bot service and nothing else —

no third-party service, no self-hosted relay in the middle. The bot is a **separate application**
w

hose administrator is your QQ account, and it was created by your own scan; an uncertified bot is
li

mited to its administrator. It is not a QQ contact you can hand out: nothing searches for it and
nob

ody can add it. There is no "someone else could message it" surface, which is why no allowlist
exist
s: the platform's own rules already are one.

**The AppSecret is a long-lived key, and it is treated as one.** It is written to DSH's credential
s

tore as a `grant` record rather than into the plugin's plaintext state file, which keeps only the
Ap
pID. Rotating it means binding again from the settings page.
Three things are still true and worth knowing:

**Conversations from QQ run with full permissions by default** — the agent does not ask before it
ac

ts. That is deliberate: a permission prompt is delivered to QQ and the task then waits there, so
on

a phone every command would stall until you answered a conversation you had walked away from. Set
**
Permission preset for QQ conversations** to `auto` (or to the profile's own policy) in the settings
page if you want the same guardrails you have at the desk.

**The agent runs as you.** It can execute commands and read and write files, with your user's
permis

sions — that is what it is for, and it means anything you can do on this machine, it can do.
So: ski

m what you asked for before walking away, and **lock the screen** when you leave. Locking does
not s
top the agent, and it keeps anyone passing by out of your desktop.
**Any session on this machine can push to your QQ by default.** That is what makes "tell me when it

is done" work: the session doing the work is usually not the one your QQ conversation is bound to,
a
nd without this it could not report its own result. Turn off **allowCrossSessionNotify** to restore
the stricter rule, where only the bound session may send.
